title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: refunding a monthly maintenance fee (tool reference)
content:
## Situation of use and capability

This tool refunds one monthly maintenance fee on a Savings & Money Market Accounts account back to that account. One call posts one refund credit that names the maintenance fee it refunds and the ground for the refund, and the account's current balance goes up by the refunded amount at once. The refund's posted date is the business day it posts: the current date when that is a business day (Monday through Friday, other than a Federal Reserve holiday), otherwise the next business day. The refund then shows in the account's activity next to the fee it refunds.

## How it is invoked

The tool is refund_savings_maintenance_fee_bf99bb2f. It is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format or allowed values |
|---|---|---|
| savings_account_id | the reference number of the savings or money market account that was charged, as returned by the savings account lookup | identifier |
| customer_id | the customer reference number of the account owner, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| source_item_id | the reference number of the monthly maintenance fee entry being refunded, as returned by the savings activity lookup | identifier |
| amount | the refunded amount | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive |
| adjustment_reason | the ground for the refund | exactly one of: courtesy_waiver (a goodwill refund of a fee that was charged correctly), bank_error (a refund of a fee that was charged contrary to the savings charter), none (not a refund ground; never used for a refund) |
| statement_cycle | the statement cycle in which the refund posts | YYYY-MM, the month in which the statement cycle that contains the refund's posted date closes |

The tool records the values it is given; it does not work out the amount, choose the ground or check eligibility.

## Return

A successful call returns:

- savings_txn_id: the reference number of the refund entry; a returned savings_txn_id means the refund posted;
- refunded_fee_id: the fee entry refunded;
- amount: USD with 2 decimal places;
- adjustment_reason: the ground recorded;
- posted_date: the business day the refund posted, YYYY-MM-DD;
- new_balance: the account's current balance after the refund, USD with 2 decimal places.

## Contract Q&A

**Which fee entries is this tool for?** Monthly maintenance fees only; the entry it posts is recorded as a refund of a monthly maintenance fee.

**Which cycle goes into statement_cycle?** The statement cycle that contains the refund's posted date, not the cycle the refunded fee belonged to.

**Can the refund carry the value none as its ground?** The value exists in the list but is never used for a refund.
